description: Subclass of AcquisitionError raised by RateLimiter.acquire() once the per-run request budget is spent, so the run fails loudly instead of continuing to hammer an API (ADR-004/006).
docstring:
Per-run HTTP request budget exhausted.

Raised by RateLimiter.acquire() when remaining_budget() would go negative. Propagates up through whichever fetch_* function was mid-iteration, through run_acquisition, to orchestration, which marks the run 'failed'. Distinguished from the base AcquisitionError so callers/tests can specifically assert on budget exhaustion rather than any generic stage failure.
postconditions: Raising this exception means at least request_budget requests were actually made in this run before stopping

edge_cases.input: Budget exhausted exactly on the last candidate's last needed request
edge_cases.expected_behavior: that request is never attempted; RequestBudgetExceeded raised in its place, and the run is reported as failed rather than silently truncated as if it had succeeded

unit_tests.name: test_raised_exactly_at_budget_limit
unit_tests.description: A RateLimiter with request_budget=5 raises RequestBudgetExceeded on the 6th acquire() call, not earlier.
unit_tests.expected: no exception on calls 1-5, RequestBudgetExceeded on call 6
